prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” roofing company for everyone — the right choice depends on your roof type, budget, whether the job is insurance-related, and what level of warranty and workmanship you want. I can help you pick the best contractor for your situation. To start, tell me your ZIP code and whether this is a routine replacement or an insurance/ storm claim.

Meanwhile, here’s a short, practical guide so you can quickly compare Dallas roofers and spot the right one:

What to require from any roofer
- Current insurance: ask for proof of general liability and workers’ comp and verify the certificates.
- Written contract and scope: materials, brand/model of shingles, underlayment, flashing, ventilation, start/finish dates, cleanup, and payment schedule.
- Permits and inspections: contractor should pull local permits and arrange final inspections if required.
- Warranties: ask separately about the manufacturer’s shingle warranty (often transferable) and the contractor’s workmanship/installation warranty (look for 10+ years when possible).
- Manufacturer certifications: GAF Master Elite, CertainTeed SELECT, Owens Corning Platinum Preferred, etc. Certified contractors often offer better warranties and training.
- References and online reputation: look at recent reviews on Google, Yelp, Angi, BBB, and ask for local references you can call.

Questions to ask each contractor
- How many years have you been working in Dallas/Fort Worth?
- Are you licensed where required and do you have local references?
- Will subcontractors be used and are they insured?
- What ventilation and underlayment will you install?
- How do you handle storm damage and insurance claims?
- Do you remove old shingles and how is debris handled (e.g., magnet sweep)?
- What is your timeline and payment schedule?

Red flags
- Door-to-door solicitations after a storm with “now or never” pressure.
- No written estimate or only a verbal quote.
- Asks for full payment up front or large cash-only requests.
- No proof of insurance or unwillingness to provide certificate.
- No local address/office or poor local references.

How I can help next
- If you give me your ZIP code I can suggest how to find top-rated Dallas roofers and the best places to check current reviews.
- If you already have 2–3 estimates, paste them here and I’ll help compare scope, pricing, and warranties.
- I can draft a short email/phone script you can use to vet contractors.

Tell me your ZIP and any other needs (roof type, insurance claim, timeline) and I’ll help narrow the best options for you.
